title: Claims Layer: machine-checkable evidence passports for claims
description: Standard-library Python reference implementation of machine-checkable evidence passports for claims. Each claim carries a kind (announcement, model, measurement, hypothesis, inference), an evidence tag (SYNTHETIC, REPORTED, TARGET, UNRUN) and machine-run checks (file digests, run-record values with capped tolerance and text binding, textual citations). Statuses are computed by the checks. A passport seals only when nothing is refuted and every measurement and numeric claim is verified; the seal is a SHA-256 over the record and its evidence files, and verify_passport() re-checks it. An optional HMAC-SHA256 keyed seal (shared secret, not a public-key signature) detects full rewrites by anyone without the key. A normalising claims firewall is measured on development and held-out corpora. A seal shows consistency and provenance, not ground truth, and is an unkeyed hash, not a signature. Demos use SYNTHETIC data.
